name: Fame or Folly
storyline:
The stakes are absolute. The winner of the Grand Festival is granted a single, binding Request from the King. It is a prize that Kings covet and Nobles scheme for, and they need a champion to claim it.

You are playing for Patronage. Every village you impress and every Noble you dazzle brings you one step closer to the capital. But be warned: push the crowd too hard with "Folly" and you'll be booed off the stage. Only the boldest plays will secure the Fame necessary to stand before the King.
summary: In a world where wars are fought on stages, compete for a single royal request from the King. Fame or Folly is a deckbuilder of deckbuilders where you draft a new trouper every turn. Recruit wisely, unlock powerful synergies, and survive the critics in this handcrafted pixel-art strategy roguelite
